function.description: PRICE HISTORY as candles. A 24h change figure cannot tell a steady climber from one spike twenty hours ago, and that difference is the whole read: the tokens that survived climbed over WEEKS in steps, the wash-traded ones peaked 2-6 hours after launch and lost 75-99%. Candles are POOL-scoped, so the pool actually read is named.
function.name: defi_data_ohlcv

address.description: The TOKEN contract address. Candles are POOL-scoped on this indexer, so the deepest pool for this token is resolved and named in the answer.

aggregate.description: Bars to merge per candle, e.g. timeframe='minute' aggregate=15.

chain.description: Chain to read candles on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

pool.description: Read this exact POOL instead of resolving one. Use it when you already know which pool you mean — a token's pools disagree.

timeframe.description: Candle window: 'day', 'hour' or 'minute'. Use 'day' to see whether a token climbed over weeks, 'hour' to see whether it went vertical.
